verdict.rationale: QuickBooks does expose a REST API (via SDKs like oauth-jsclient and the PHP SDK with CRUD examples) and even an MCP server claiming '145 Total Tools - Complete coverage of QuickBooks Online API,' suggesting broad but not explicitly verified UI-API parity. However, there's no first-party claim or evidence that AI-driven UI features (Intuit Intelligence chat, Payroll AI, funding insights, bank reconciliation reports, industry benchmarking) are all accessible via the API, and discovery artifacts like llms.txt/openapi.json are missing (404s), undermining confidence in full parity. missing for 10: explicit parity statement covering AI/reporting/reconciliation features, working OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation that API-only workflows replicate all UI capabilities.
